en.text: Work super hard. That's the single most important thing.

zh.text: 超级努力工作。这是最重要的事情。

en.text: If you're not failing, you're not innovating enough.

zh.text: 如果你没有在失败，说明你创新得不够。

en.text: I don't ever give up. I'd have to be dead or completely incapacitated.

zh.text: 我从不放弃。除非我死了或者完全丧失能力。

en.text: Being a hardcore engineer means you never stop until the problem is solved.

zh.text: 做一个硬核工程师意味着你永远不会停下来，直到问题被解决。

en.text: The people who work for me are expected to work just as hard as I do.

zh.text: 为我工作的人被期望和我一样努力工作。

en.text: I lead by example. If I'm sleeping at the factory, my team knows I'm serious.

zh.text: 我以身作则。如果我睡在工厂里，我的团队就知道我是认真的。

en.text: Persistence is very important. You should not give up unless you are forced to give up.

zh.text: 坚持非常重要。你不应该放弃，除非你被迫放弃。

en.text: I think leadership means being the first one in and the last one out.

zh.text: 我认为领导力意味着第一个到，最后一个走。

en.text: The people I hire are the ones who have proven they can build things from scratch.

zh.text: 我雇佣的人是那些已经证明他们能从零开始建造东西的人。

en.text: I don't believe in hierarchical management. The best ideas should win regardless of where they come from.

zh.text: 我不相信层级管理。最好的想法应该获胜，不管它来自哪里。

en.text: When I was building my first company, I slept in the office and showered at the YMCA.

zh.text: 当我创办第一家公司时，我睡在办公室，在YMCA洗澡。

en.text: A company is just a group of people working together. The culture is what makes or breaks it.

zh.text: 公司就是一群人一起工作。文化决定成败。

en.text: I don't manage by email. I walk the factory floor and talk to people directly.

zh.text: 我不通过电子邮件管理。我走在工厂车间，直接与人交谈。

en.text: If you want to build something amazing, you need to surround yourself with amazing people.

zh.text: 如果你想建造令人惊叹的东西，你需要让自己被令人惊叹的人包围。

en.text: I've missed many important family events because I was at the factory or the launch site.

zh.text: 我错过了许多重要的家庭活动，因为我在工厂或发射场。

en.text: The hardcore work ethic is what separates Tesla and SpaceX from other companies.

zh.text: 硬核工作精神是Tesla和SpaceX区别于其他公司的关键。

en.text: I expect people to tell me when I'm wrong. If they don't, I can't fix the problem.

zh.text: 我希望人们在我犯错时告诉我。如果他们不告诉我，我就无法解决问题。

en.text: The best leaders are the ones who do the hardest work themselves.

zh.text: 最好的领导者是那些自己完成最困难工作的人。

en.text: I don't have a work-life balance. I have work-life integration. It's all one thing.

zh.text: 我没有工作与生活的平衡。我有工作与生活的融合。它们是一回事。

en.text: When you're building something new, you have to be willing to be misunderstood for a long time.

zh.text: 当你建造新东西时，你必须愿意在很长一段时间内被误解。
